name: seo-bw-extension
description: Instant SEO analysis: scores, meta tags, headings, schema, links, and tech stack detection. Dev tooling only — the extension itself ships as manifest.json + src/ (no build step).

scripts.build: echo 'No build step needed - load unpacked in Chrome'
scripts.zip: cd extension && zip -r ../seo-bw-extension.zip manifest.json lib/ src/ -x '*.DS_Store'
scripts.check:zip: npm run zip && (node scripts/check-zip-manifest.mjs; rc=$?; rm -f seo-bw-extension.zip; exit $rc)
scripts.zip:themes: for t in bandwagon-neon-night bandwagon-neon-day; do (cd themes/$t && rm -f ../../seo-bw-theme-${t#bandwagon-}.zip && zip -qr ../../seo-bw-theme-${t#bandwagon-}.zip manifest.json images -x '*.DS_Store'); done && ls -la seo-bw-theme-*.zip

author: SEO Bandwagon <kyle@seobandwagon.com>
